chapters.title: 阴影与死档
chapters.text: 上世纪七八十年代，加利福尼亚州笼罩在巨大的阴影之中。一名代号金州杀手的凶徒接连作案几十起，随后销声匿迹。现场留下的微量毛发与物证，在当年的技术条件下无法提取有效线索，最终成了躺在档案库里厚厚的死档。谁也没有想到，三十年后，这批沉睡的物证将彻底改写刑事侦查的历史。

chapters.title: 盲区与飞跃
chapters.text: 传统的法医比对依赖STR基因分型，必须在现有的前科犯罪数据库中碰撞出完全吻合的人。如果凶手从未被捕，数据库里就查无此人。冷案之所以冰封数十年，根源正是传统刑侦数据库的盲区。然而进入二十一世纪，高通量基因测序技术突飞猛进，让法医学界迎来了一场划时代的认知飞跃。

chapters.title: 表型分析的破晓
chapters.text: 第一项突破性技术是DNA表型分析。科学家不再只把基因当成一组身份条码，而是通过海量单核苷酸多态性位点，直接反推生理外貌特征。从几微升陈旧物证中，算法能够精准推断出嫌疑人的虹膜颜色、发色、肤色乃至祖源构成，甚至生成预测画像，直接刺破了未知幽灵的伪装迷雾。

chapters.title: 织网
chapters.text: 真正扭转全局的是法医遗传谱系学。调查人员做出了一个前所未有的决定：他们没有继续死守警方封闭数据库，而是将嫌疑人的基因数据上传到了公开的家谱基因检索平台GEDmatch。在这里，几万名普通公众为了寻找远祖上传了自己的基因，这也无意间织就了一张覆盖全社会的基因互联网络。

chapters.title: 家族树逆推
chapters.text: 系统没有匹配到凶手本人，却揪出了几位共享基因片段的远房表亲。遗传谱系学家柯琳·菲茨帕特里克与调查组顺藤摸瓜，沿着十九世纪的曾祖父母向上回溯，绘制出拥有数千名后代的庞大家族树。通过逐条排查支系、年龄、居住地与外貌表型，嫌疑范围被奇迹般收窄到唯一个体。

chapters.title: 落网与科学之光
chapters.text: 二〇一八年，警方暗中提取了已经七十二岁的前警官约瑟夫·迪安杰洛丢弃的物品，确认DNA百分之百吻合。满头白发的恶魔终于落网。从一根微量毛发到家族树检索，法医基因组学让几十年前的冷案全面复活。基因不会说谎，岁月也无法洗脱罪恶，科学终将照亮一切被遗忘的黑暗角落。

shots.purpose: 展现上世纪七十年代加州夜幕下的宁静郊区街道与沉重夜雾
shots.prompt: Dusk on a quiet 1970s Northern California suburban street: modest ranch houses with warm windows, parked station wagons at the curbs, amber street lamps glowing through low fog, deep blue shadows under the last strip of daylight. Camera: one locked-off wide shot from the middle of the empty asphalt street, holding the same framing while the fog drifts very slowly between the lampposts. No people, no readable text.

shots.purpose: 警方侦查员在夜间勘查现场，手电筒光束划过窗框
shots.prompt: Night backyard of a 1970s California suburban house, seen over the shoulder of a detective in a tan trench coat who stands still with his back to the lens, the beam of a chrome flashlight resting steadily on wooden fence slats, faint dust drifting in the beam. The detective stays standing in the same spot for the whole take, never turning around, his face never visible. The camera holds one fixed over-the-shoulder angle with at most a very slow two-inch drift forward; no scene change, no readable text.

The camera is a locked-off macro tripod shot with no movement for the whole take; the sleeve, the hair and the tag never move, no hands enter the frame, no scene change, no readable text.

shots.purpose: 警方冷案档案库中排列整齐的厚重铁架与牛皮纸档案盒
shots.prompt: Long dim evidence repository with tall steel shelving rows holding thousands of labeled brown cardboard boxes receding into darkness under cold fluorescent tubes. The camera makes one very slow straight lateral tracking move to the right along the aisle and nothing else: the shelf rows and boxes stay fixed in place for the whole take, no forward motion, no scene change, no people, no readable text.

shots.purpose: 九十年代法医实验室中传统的凝胶电泳板与条形码比对
shots.prompt: Close view of an illuminated laboratory lightbox mounted on a wall, displaying three DNA autoradiograph films with dark horizontal bands, a gloved hand resting a plastic ruler steadily at the edge of the glass. The camera stays locked off on its tripod aimed straight at the lightbox for the whole take; the films and the hand hold the same position with only tiny finger adjustments, no camera movement, no scene change, no readable text.

shots.purpose: 老式CRT监视器上显示CODIS数据库查询'无匹配结果'的冷峻屏幕
shots.prompt: Late-1990s night detective office: a gray-haired investigator in a shirt and tie sits at a desk facing a bulky CRT computer terminal, seen in profile from his left side, green database text glowing on the screen, shelves of paper files behind him. This is one single continuous shot from this exact side angle for the entire 7 seconds: the man stays seated in the same posture facing the screen, only his hands and eyes move slightly, and the shelves, files, desk and equipment behind and around him stay exactly the same shapes in every frame. The camera never moves, never circles, the background never changes, no other people, no readable text.

Camera: locked-off side angle while the hair image slides slowly across the monitor and the analyst watches almost motionless. No readable text.
